evidence_classes.derived: arithmetic over measured inputs with no free parameters (calibration bins, the CAL threshold sweep, per-sample router paths under a frozen tau)
evidence_classes.estimated: a modeling assumption the reader is invited to move (c_misroute, c_human, the Tier A amortized-zero compute charge) — never a measurement
evidence_classes.measured: read off a real observation: a logged run metric, a per-call receipt, or a deterministic derivation from a frozen per-example artifact
evidence_classes.projected: an extrapolation to conditions not evaluated (e.g. cost at a volume no run reached); carries the assumption that produced it
